_comment: POST this to /api/regulatory-updates to simulate the horizon-scanning provider. Every source_span below is quoted verbatim from the Cybersecurity (Amendment) Act 2024 (Act 19 of 2024), which introduces Part 3A and sections 16A-16K governing designated providers responsible for third-party-owned critical information infrastructure. The old_value in each change is the position the firm's pre-amendment precedents were drafted against, not a figure stated by the Act.
title: Cybersecurity (Amendment) Act 2024 — designated provider reporting obligations

changes.source_span: The designated provider responsible for third-party-owned critical information infrastructure must, not later than 14 days after receiving from the owner a report of an audit or a cybersecurity risk assessment, furnish a copy of the report of the audit or assessment to the Commissioner.
the designated provider responsible for third-party-owned critical information infrastructure must notify the Commissioner of the change not later than 14 days after the change is made.
